verdict.rationale: Docs confirm PR checks/pass-fail status posted to GitHub or GitLab and PR-based fix workflow (gecko/* PR with patch), covering the core of the story, but there's no explicit evidence of inline PR *comments* on specific lines (only checks) and no independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific feature. Community evidence raises accuracy concerns (false positives, missed vulns) that don't directly contradict PR-check delivery but weaken confidence in finding quality overall. missing for 10: evidence of inline per-line PR comments (not just pass/fail checks), independent/hands-on verification of the PR-check UX.
